author: astralgamer22
quote: Absolute masterpiece, a 1:1 remake, the environment, characters, interactions, mechanics are all integrated into a world full of magic that makes you feel like you are actually a hero trying to save a princess, we can see the love they gave on this game, there are no flaws, everything about it is extremely polished and well done, great job
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: astralgamer22
quote: Althought gta 6 is surprisingly realistic, it's structure it's negative, repetitive missions, honor system in a gta game, this doesnt feel like gta anymore, 30 fps is something we used to deal 8-10 years ago, the bare minimum would be for us having a performance mode, but not even that, plenty of bugs, cmon, cyberpunk got obliterated for less than that, the only thing that sustain this game is hype, and i understand why it is hyped, but for 13 years of development, it is a dissapointment, as a rdr2 fan, there are many similarities between those two games, but gta is gta, rdr2 is rdr2, point.
